diagnosis.cause: The protected host sets MNCS_ENV_PERSISTENCE_TRANSPORT=control-rpc. Temporary file-backed CLI tests inherited it and were routed to RPC despite --persistence file.
diagnosis.resolution: The test helper now clears that process-local dispatch switch only while executing explicit file-backed fixtures. Control configuration, bwrap policy, and canonical Store access are unchanged.

limitations: This run validates Environment continuity logic using temporary test-owned file Stores; it does not add canonical Store publication evidence.
Compiler and Forge claims remain held by prior owners; their repositories were not tested or modified in this run.
